_about: Special rooms (user's choice): from `fromFloor` on, a floor has `chance` to be a special room instead of a fight. Never a boss floor, never the floor right before a boss, never two rooms in a row. The floor number still goes up. `kinds` = which room, picked by `weight`. Rules: src/systems/rooms.js; the scene part: src/scenes/roomMethods.js; prop art: src/data/roomProps.json.

treasure.name: Treasure Room
treasure.hint: Tap a chest to open it

mimic.name: A Lone Chest
mimic.hint: Tap the chest... if you dare

dealer.name: Skill Dealer
dealer.hint: Tap the dealer to see the pages
dealer._pages: what the dealer offers: skillBooks.json contents.dealer (2 stat + 3 modifier pages)

puzzle.name: Puzzle Room
puzzle._shuffle: user: easy puzzle. The board is the solved one slid 8 times at random, so it is always solvable in 8 moves or fewer.
